chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi from Al-Abbas ibn Amir from Al-Arzami from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'A time will come upon the people in which dominion is not attained except by killing and tyranny, nor wealth except by usurpation and stinginess, nor love except by extracting the religion and following personal desires.'

So whoever experiences that time, and is patient with poverty while having the ability to be wealthy, and is patient with hatred while having the ability to be loved, and is patient with humiliation while having the ability to be honored, Allah will grant him the reward of fifty truthful ones (siddiqun) from those who affirmed my prophethood.

key_terms.اسْتِخْرَاجِ الدِّينِ: Extracting the religion (using faith for worldly gain)
key_terms.الصِّدِّيقُ: The Truthful One (a high rank of believers)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a person who remains patient in poverty and humiliation during a corrupt era?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the eschatological signs of moral decay where power and wealth are acquired through injustice, contrasting them with the spiritual merit of voluntary restraint. It emphasizes that enduring poverty, enmity, and humiliation while possessing the means to avoid them yields the reward of fifty truthful ones (Siddiqun), a concept deeply rooted in Shia theology regarding the patience of the Imams and the faithful during times of oppression.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Al Abbas Bin Aamir, from Al Arzamy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘There would be coming such a time period upon the people that they would not be attaining a kingdom except by the killing and the tyranny, nor (attaining) riches except by the usurpation and the stinginess, nor the love except by the removal of the Religion and following of the personal desires.

So the one who comes across that time period, and he observes patience upon the poverty despite being able upon the riches, and observes patience upon the hatred despite being able upon the love, and observes patience upon the humiliation despite being able upon the honour, Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> would Give him the Rewards of fifty truthful ones from the ones who ratified me<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 12. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-kufl from al-‘ Abbas ibn ‘Amir from al-‘Arzami from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘A time will come upon people when kingdom can be achieved only by committing murders and tyranny. Wealth can only be achieved through usurpation and stinginess. Love and harmony can be established only by exclusion of religion and by following desires.

Those living at such a time must exercise patience in poverty despite the accessability of wealth to them, be patient against the hatred of people toward them even though they can establish love and harmony. They must exercise patience in humiliation even though they can rise with respectable (position). To each one of such persons Allah will grant a reward equal to the reward for fifty truthful people of those who have acknowledged my message.’”
